cos.desc: Explain the principles, paradigms, and real-world applications of unsupervised learning for exploratory data analysis and knowledge discovery.
Apply clustering, similarity measures, and dimensionality reduction techniques to identify hidden structures in unlabeled datasets.
Analyze partition-based, hierarchical, density-based, and probabilistic learning techniques to select appropriate unsupervised models for diverse problem domains.
Evaluate clustering, association rule mining, anomaly detection, and representation learning outcomes using appropriate validation metrics and visualization techniques.
Evaluate the effectiveness of multiple unsupervised learning techniques in solving real-world pattern discovery, customer analytics, and anomaly detection problems.
Apply end-to-end unsupervised learning workflows involving data preprocessing, model development, visualization, interpretation, and deployment to solve complex domain-specific challenges.

caScheme.summary: Project (Compulsory, 77.78% weightage = 35 marks) + Best 1 of 2 Tests (22.22% weightage = 10 marks)

tasks.mode: Team/Individual Code Repository + Live Viva + Technical Documentation
tasks.nature: End-to-end unsupervised problem formulation, data scraping/curation, clustering/manifold reduction, model validation, and deployment dashboard.
Foundations of unsupervised learning, similarity metrics, k-Means, k-Medoids, and hierarchical clustering mechanics.
Density-based clustering (DBSCAN), PCA, t-SNE, UMAP, Market Basket Analysis, and Anomaly Detection algorithms.

practicals.title: Exploratory Data Analysis & Similarity Metrics
practicals.desc: Analyze customer behavior patterns by performing exploratory data analysis and evaluating Euclidean, Manhattan, and Cosine similarity measures on multi-attribute customer profiles.

practicals.title: k-Means & k-Medoids Segmentation
practicals.desc: Develop a customer segmentation solution by implementing and comparing k-Means and k-Medoids (PAM) clustering techniques on retail transaction datasets.

practicals.title: Scalable k-Means From Scratch
practicals.desc: Design a scalable clustering model by implementing k-Means from scratch, analyzing initialization strategies, vectorizing distance calculations, and validating convergence.

practicals.title: Impact of Preprocessing & Scaling
practicals.desc: Investigate the influence of feature scaling (StandardScaler vs MinMaxScaler vs RobustScaler) and missing value handling on cluster geometry and separation boundaries.

practicals.title: Clustering Validation & Optimization
practicals.desc: Determine optimal cluster configurations by computing Elbow Method (Inertia/WCSS), Silhouette Coefficients, and Davies–Bouldin Index across synthetic and empirical datasets.

practicals.title: Agglomerative Hierarchical Clustering
practicals.desc: Analyze hierarchical relationships in unlabeled data by constructing dendrograms and benchmarking single, complete, average, and Ward linkage strategies.

practicals.title: DBSCAN Density-Based Clustering
practicals.desc: Develop a density-based spatial clustering solution using DBSCAN, analyzing the sensitivity of epsilon (ε) and MinPts, and isolating spatial noise/outlier samples.

practicals.title: Comparative Clustering Benchmarks
practicals.desc: Evaluate partition-based, hierarchical, and density-based clustering models against non-spherical geometric distributions (concentric rings, crescent moons, anisotropic blobs).

practicals.title: Principal Component Analysis (PCA)
practicals.desc: Develop an efficient feature representation model by applying PCA to reduce dimensionality, computing explained variance ratios, scree plots, and eigenvalue decomposition.

practicals.title: Non-Linear Manifold Learning (t-SNE & UMAP)
practicals.desc: Compare non-linear dimensionality reduction algorithms by projecting high-dimensional datasets (MNIST digits, Fashion-MNIST) into 2D/3D latent visual embeddings.

practicals.title: Market Basket Analysis with Apriori & FP-Growth
practicals.desc: Extract actionable association rules from retail supermarket transaction logs by configuring Support, Confidence, Lift, and Conviction thresholds.

practicals.title: Anomaly Detection Frameworks
practicals.desc: Develop an anomaly detection pipeline comparing Isolation Forest, Local Outlier Factor (LOF), and One-Class SVM on skewed credit card fraud and network intrusion logs.

practicals.title: Gaussian Mixture Models (GMM) & Soft Clustering
practicals.desc: Implement soft clustering with Gaussian Mixture Models, estimating covariance types (spherical, tied, diag, full) and optimizing BIC/AIC criteria via EM.

practicals.title: End-to-End Capstone Project Pipeline
practicals.desc: Synthesize an end-to-end unsupervised pipeline incorporating raw data ingestion, preprocessing, dimensionality reduction, model clustering, evaluation metrics, and interactive dashboarding.

practicals.title: Practical Spill-Over, Project Viva & Code Review
practicals.desc: Conduct capstone code review, rubric-based technical viva voce, model deployment verification, and comprehensive practical evaluation.

lectures.topic: Foundations of Unsupervised Learning & Core Paradigms
lectures.desc: Introduction to unsupervised learning principles; Comparison between Supervised, Unsupervised, and Semi-Supervised learning paradigms; Unlabeled data challenges and value extraction in modern AI.
lectures.outcome: Understand core unsupervised paradigms and differentiate unsupervised workflows from supervised regression and classification.
lectures.pedagogy: Venn diagrams comparing ML paradigms, interactive taxonomy whiteboard session.
lectures.example: Customer segmentation in Amazon and Netflix user personalization.

lectures.topic: Problem Formulation & Real-World Industry Use Cases
lectures.desc: Formulating business problems into unsupervised learning tasks; Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) for structure discovery; Use cases across finance, healthcare, and retail.
lectures.outcome: Formulate unstructured business problems as clustering, dimensionality reduction, or anomaly detection tasks.
lectures.pedagogy: Case study analysis of fintech and e-commerce transaction workflows.
lectures.example: Credit card transaction fraud identification and customer churn clustering.

lectures.topic: Distance & Geometric Similarity Metrics
lectures.desc: Mathematical formulations and properties of distance metrics: Euclidean (L2 norm), Manhattan (L1 city block), Minkowski, and Cosine similarity for high-dimensional vectors.
lectures.outcome: Calculate and select appropriate distance/similarity metrics tailored to feature scales and vector geometries.
lectures.pedagogy: Geometric intuition board work; 'As the crow flies vs city grid' analogy.
lectures.example: Text document similarity in search engines and GPS routing distance computations.

lectures.topic: Partition-Based Clustering: k-Means Mechanics
lectures.desc: Concept of hard vs soft clustering; k-Means algorithm formulation; Centroid initialization methods; Standard Lloyd's algorithm iteration and convergence criteria.
lectures.outcome: Explain k-Means algorithmic mechanics and implement iterative centroid convergence.
lectures.pedagogy: Step-by-step dry-run on 2D scatter plots; Colored magnets on magnetic board.
lectures.example: Grouping retail customers based on annual income and spending score.

lectures.topic: Advanced k-Means: k-Means++ Initialization & Pitfalls
lectures.desc: Vulnerability of standard k-Means to poor local minima; k-Means++ probabilistic initialization proof and behavior; Convergence guarantees and computational complexity.
lectures.outcome: Apply k-Means++ to safeguard against suboptimal centroid initialization traps.
lectures.pedagogy: Live Jupyter Notebook simulation comparing random seeds against k-Means++.
lectures.example: Clustering geographical weather station readings across national grid sensors.

lectures.topic: Robust Partitioning: k-Medoids (PAM) & Preprocessing
lectures.desc: Partitioning Around Medoids (PAM) algorithm; Contrast between artificial mean centroids and actual exemplar medoids; Sensitivity to outliers; Impact of feature scaling and standardization.
lectures.outcome: Select k-Medoids over k-Means when dataset contains heavy outliers and explain scaling prerequisites.
lectures.pedagogy: Interactive comparative demonstration with and without extreme outlier injection.
lectures.example: Hospital patient length-of-stay clustering with anomalous critical care outliers.

lectures.topic: Scalable Clustering: MiniBatch k-Means
lectures.desc: Big Data clustering limitations; MiniBatch k-Means stochastic gradient descent updates; Memory footprint reduction and convergence speedup trade-offs.
lectures.outcome: Deploy MiniBatch k-Means on massive streaming datasets that exceed system RAM.
lectures.pedagogy: Algorithmic complexity profiling (Big-O time and memory comparisons).
lectures.example: Large-scale web clickstream event clustering for digital advertising platforms.

lectures.topic: Cluster Validation: Internal Metrics & Elbow Method
lectures.desc: Within-Cluster Sum of Squares (WCSS / Inertia); Elbow Method mechanics and ambiguity pitfalls; Between-Cluster Sum of Squares (BCSS); Davies–Bouldin Index.
lectures.outcome: Evaluate clustering compactness and separation using inertia curves and Davies–Bouldin indices.
lectures.pedagogy: Graphical curvature analysis; Live interactive parameter tuning slider.
lectures.example: Optimal product category tier determination in an e-commerce catalog.

lectures.topic: Advanced Validation: Silhouette Analysis & Visualizers
lectures.desc: Silhouette Coefficient mathematical formulation: intra-cluster distance a(i) vs nearest-cluster distance b(i); Interpreting negative and near-zero silhouette values; Yellowbrick silhouette plots.
lectures.outcome: Interpret silhouette plots to identify misclassified border points and determine optimal k.
lectures.pedagogy: Knife-blade silhouette distribution visualizations and heatmaps.
lectures.example: Telecom customer contract plan grouping and churn risk tiering.

lectures.topic: Hierarchical Clustering: Agglomerative Mechanics
lectures.desc: Bottom-up agglomerative vs top-down divisive clustering; Proximity matrix computation; Linkage criteria: Single (minimum distance), Complete (maximum distance), Average, and Ward's minimum variance.
lectures.outcome: Construct agglomerative cluster trees and evaluate linkage behaviors on elongated vs spherical shapes.
lectures.pedagogy: Step-by-step matrix reduction board exercise.
lectures.example: Phylogenetic biological tree synthesis and evolutionary gene family mapping.

lectures.topic: Academic Task: Test 1 / Continuous Assessment Mid-Review
lectures.desc: Objective and Subjective In-Class Assessment (CA Test 1) covering Foundations, Partition-Based Clustering, Distance Metrics, and Hierarchical Clustering Theory.
lectures.outcome: Demonstrate conceptual mastery and problem-solving skills across Units 1 & 2.
lectures.pedagogy: Formal structured written/LMS assessment test.
lectures.example: Evaluation of algorithmic time complexity, distance derivations, and linkage matrices.

lectures.topic: Dendrogram Interpretation & Tree Pruning
lectures.desc: Reading and interpreting dendrogram heights; Horizontal cut line placement; Determining natural cluster boundaries; Cophenetic correlation coefficient for tree fidelity.
lectures.outcome: Determine optimal cluster partitions by pruning dendrograms at statistically defensible heights.
lectures.pedagogy: Interactive dendrogram cutting tool in Python/SciPy.
lectures.example: Document taxonomy generation and news article topical hierarchy creation.

lectures.topic: Density-Based Clustering: DBSCAN Fundamentals
lectures.desc: Limitations of centroid and hierarchical clustering on irregular topologies; DBSCAN core concepts: Epsilon (ε) neighborhood, MinPts; Core points, Border points, and Noise points.
lectures.outcome: Explain density reachability and connectivity; Isolate non-convex clusters with noise filtering.
lectures.pedagogy: Visual animation of density wave propagation across arbitrary shaped point clouds.
lectures.example: Urban traffic bottleneck detection and GPS taxi drop-off hotspot identification.

lectures.topic: Mid-Term Spill Over & Clustering Algorithmic Review
lectures.desc: Buffer lecture for complex topics: Benchmarking k-Means vs Hierarchical vs DBSCAN across time complexity, memory, shape flexibility, and noise resilience; Mid-term doubt clearing.
lectures.outcome: Synthesize comparative trade-offs among all partition, hierarchical, and density-based clustering models.
lectures.pedagogy: Comprehensive matrix comparison and live benchmark shootout on non-convex datasets.
lectures.example: Selecting suitable clustering paradigms for astronomical galaxy survey data.

lectures.topic: Curse of Dimensionality & Dimensionality Reduction Intro
lectures.desc: Geometric phenomena in high dimensions: volume concentration, distance homogenization; Need for dimensionality reduction: noise suppression, visualization, and compute efficiency.
lectures.outcome: Analyze the curse of dimensionality and justify dimensional compression for downstream ML.
lectures.pedagogy: Geometric hypercube vs hypersphere volume ratio thought experiment.
lectures.example: Processing genomic microarray data with 20,000 genes over 100 patient samples.

lectures.topic: Principal Component Analysis (PCA): Geometric Intuition
lectures.desc: Linear dimensionality reduction; Direction of maximum variance; Orthogonal projection axes; Covariance matrix computation; Eigenvalues, eigenvectors, and principal components.
lectures.outcome: Derive principal components geometrically and interpret variance preservation.
lectures.pedagogy: 2D/3D dynamic projection rotations; Ellipsoid variance axis animation.
lectures.example: Facial recognition eigenfaces (AT&T Cambridge face database).

lectures.topic: PCA Practical Implementation: Scree Plots & Explained Variance
lectures.desc: Cumulative explained variance ratio calculation; Scree plot construction; Kaiser criterion for component retention; Reconstruction error and lossy compression analysis.
lectures.outcome: Select the optimal number of principal components balancing compression ratio with information loss.
lectures.pedagogy: Hands-on coding walkthrough on biomedical datasets using Scikit-learn PCA.
lectures.example: Image compression and noise reduction in MRI and CT scans.

lectures.topic: Non-Linear Manifold Learning: t-SNE
lectures.desc: Limitations of linear PCA on curved manifolds; t-Distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding (t-SNE); Probability distributions over pairs; Perplexity parameter tuning; Local vs global preservation.
lectures.outcome: Apply t-SNE to visualize high-dimensional data in 2D/3D and configure perplexity effectively.
lectures.pedagogy: Interactive distortion visualization; Misreading t-SNE plots guide.
lectures.example: Visualizing high-dimensional single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) cell clusters.

lectures.topic: Scalable Manifold Learning: UMAP & Autoencoders Intuition
lectures.desc: Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP) Riemannian geometry principles; Global structure preservation comparison (t-SNE vs UMAP); Conceptual introduction to Deep Autoencoders.
lectures.outcome: Contrast UMAP and t-SNE in scalability and global structure fidelity; Understand latent bottleneck autoencoders.
lectures.pedagogy: Side-by-side run on MNIST 70,000 digits benchmarking execution time and visual clustering.
lectures.example: Visualizing 100,000 word embeddings in Natural Language Processing (Word2Vec / BERT).

lectures.topic: Academic Task: Test 2 / Continuous Assessment Review
lectures.desc: Objective and Subjective In-Class Assessment (CA Test 2) covering DBSCAN, Dimensionality Reduction (PCA, t-SNE, UMAP), and Feature Representation Learning.
lectures.outcome: Demonstrate rigorous theoretical and practical problem-solving across Units 3 & 4.
lectures.pedagogy: Formal structured written/LMS assessment test.
lectures.example: Evaluation of covariance matrices, eigenvector calculations, and manifold hyperparameters.

lectures.topic: Association Rule Mining: Apriori Algorithm Mechanics
lectures.desc: Market Basket Analysis foundations; Itemsets, transactions, and rule formats (A -> B); Key metrics: Support, Confidence, Lift, and Conviction; Apriori downward-closure property.
lectures.outcome: Extract strong association rules and interpret Lift to discard coincidental item correlations.
lectures.pedagogy: Supermarket shopping cart board game with transaction frequency tables.
lectures.example: Amazon 'Frequently Bought Together' cross-sell recommendation engines.

lectures.topic: Capstone Project Review: Phase-1 Architecture Evaluation
lectures.desc: Formal evaluation of Continuous Assessment Capstone Project: Problem definition, EDA, data pipeline, and initial model benchmarking presented by student groups.
lectures.outcome: Defend end-to-end unsupervised design choices, baseline models, and code architecture.
lectures.pedagogy: Interactive peer critique and rubric-based faculty technical viva.
lectures.example: Live code walkthrough of end-to-end industry analytics repositories.

lectures.topic: Scalable Rule Mining: FP-Growth (Frequent Pattern Tree)
lectures.desc: Computational bottlenecks of candidate generation in Apriori; FP-Tree compact data structure construction; Mining frequent itemsets without candidate generation.
lectures.outcome: Deploy FP-Growth algorithm for orders-of-magnitude faster association mining on sparse datasets.
lectures.pedagogy: Interactive FP-tree building walkthrough with prefix path mining.
lectures.example: Healthcare adverse drug reaction combination mining from prescription databases.

lectures.topic: Anomaly & Outlier Detection: Statistical & Distance Methods
lectures.desc: Defining anomalies: point, contextual, and collective outliers; Z-score and IQR bounds; Distance-based k-NN outlier scores; Local Outlier Factor (LOF) local density estimation.
lectures.outcome: Differentiate global and local outliers and apply LOF to non-uniform density datasets.
lectures.pedagogy: 2D scatter visual highlighting isolated outliers vs local cluster-edge outliers.
lectures.example: Network intrusion detection identifying malicious port-scanning patterns.

lectures.topic: Tree-Based Anomaly Detection: Isolation Forest
lectures.desc: Isolation Forest core philosophy: isolating anomalies rather than profiling normal points; Recursive random partitioning; Average path length in isolation trees; Anomaly score computation.
lectures.outcome: Implement Isolation Forest for high-dimensional anomaly detection with linear time complexity.
lectures.pedagogy: Tree partitioning animation illustrating rapid isolation of rare anomalous points.
lectures.example: Financial banking transaction fraud screening and automated anti-money laundering (AML).

lectures.topic: Probabilistic Clustering: Gaussian Mixture Models (GMM)
lectures.desc: Probability density estimation; Mixture models; Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm: E-step (posterior probabilities) and M-step (parameter updates); Covariance constraints.
lectures.outcome: Apply Gaussian Mixture Models for soft probabilistic clustering and density estimation.
lectures.pedagogy: Overlapping Gaussian bell curves demonstration with soft probabilistic assignment.
lectures.example: Speaker diarization and acoustic speech pattern clustering in audio processing.

lectures.topic: Model Evaluation, Stability Analysis & End-to-End Pipeline
lectures.desc: External validation metrics when ground truth is partially available: Adjusted Rand Index (ARI), Normalized Mutual Information (NMI); Cluster stability under perturbation; Pipeline deployment.
lectures.outcome: Validate unsupervised models using ARI/NMI and evaluate clustering robustness via bootstrap resampling.
lectures.pedagogy: Sensitivity analysis charts and deployment architectural diagrams.
lectures.example: Verifying customer segmentation model stability across consecutive quarters.

lectures.topic: Spill Over Lecture 1: Advanced Anomaly & Deep Generative Models
lectures.desc: Buffer lecture for advanced applications: Deep Autoencoders for anomaly detection, Variational Autoencoders (VAE) overview, and Self-Organizing Maps (SOM).
lectures.outcome: Appraise state-of-the-art unsupervised deep representation and reconstruction methods.
lectures.pedagogy: Architecture diagrams and code demonstration of autoencoder reconstruction error.
lectures.example: Industrial sensor telemetry predictive maintenance and turbine fault anticipation.

lectures.topic: Spill Over Lecture 2: Real-World Case Studies & Deployment
lectures.desc: Buffer lecture for end-to-end case studies: Deploying unsupervised models with Scikit-learn pipelines; Model serialization (joblib/pickle); Real-time inference latency.
lectures.outcome: Package and deploy unsupervised pipelines as web endpoints or batch analytics jobs.
lectures.pedagogy: Interactive live demo deploying a clustering REST API endpoint.
lectures.example: Production deployment of customer classification microservice on AWS / Docker.

lectures.topic: Spill Over Lecture 3: Comprehensive Course Review & Capstone Viva
lectures.desc: Comprehensive review of all 6 course units; Summary of key algorithmic decisions; Final Project evaluation, student Q&A, and ETT preparation guidance.
lectures.outcome: Synthesize complete knowledge of unsupervised learning algorithms and excel in final evaluations.
lectures.pedagogy: Rapid-fire conceptual quiz, algorithmic decision cheat-sheet distribution.
lectures.example: Preparation for senior machine learning engineer and data scientist technical interviews.

lectures.desc: Buffer lecture for complex topics: Benchmarking k-Means vs Hierarchical vs DBSCAN across time complexity, memory, shape flexibility, and noise resilience; Mid-term doubt clearing.
lectures.outcome: Synthesize comparative trade-offs among all partition, hierarchical, and density-based clustering models.
lectures.pedagogy: Comprehensive matrix comparison and live benchmark shootout on non-convex datasets.
lectures.example: Selecting suitable clustering paradigms for astronomical galaxy survey data.

lectures.topic: Curse of Dimensionality & Dimensionality Reduction Intro
lectures.desc: Geometric phenomena in high dimensions: volume concentration, distance homogenization; Need for dimensionality reduction: noise suppression, visualization, and compute efficiency.
lectures.outcome: Analyze the curse of dimensionality and justify dimensional compression for downstream ML.
lectures.pedagogy: Geometric hypercube vs hypersphere volume ratio thought experiment.
lectures.example: Processing genomic microarray data with 20,000 genes over 100 patient samples.

lectures.topic: Principal Component Analysis (PCA): Geometric Intuition
lectures.desc: Linear dimensionality reduction; Direction of maximum variance; Orthogonal projection axes; Covariance matrix computation; Eigenvalues, eigenvectors, and principal components.
lectures.outcome: Derive principal components geometrically and interpret variance preservation.
lectures.pedagogy: 2D/3D dynamic projection rotations; Ellipsoid variance axis animation.
lectures.example: Facial recognition eigenfaces (AT&T Cambridge face database).

lectures.topic: PCA Practical Implementation: Scree Plots & Explained Variance
lectures.desc: Cumulative explained variance ratio calculation; Scree plot construction; Kaiser criterion for component retention; Reconstruction error and lossy compression analysis.
lectures.outcome: Select the optimal number of principal components balancing compression ratio with information loss.
lectures.pedagogy: Hands-on coding walkthrough on biomedical datasets using Scikit-learn PCA.
lectures.example: Image compression and noise reduction in MRI and CT scans.

lectures.topic: Non-Linear Manifold Learning: t-SNE
lectures.desc: Limitations of linear PCA on curved manifolds; t-Distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding (t-SNE); Probability distributions over pairs; Perplexity parameter tuning; Local vs global preservation.
lectures.outcome: Apply t-SNE to visualize high-dimensional data in 2D/3D and configure perplexity effectively.
lectures.pedagogy: Interactive distortion visualization; Misreading t-SNE plots guide.
lectures.example: Visualizing high-dimensional single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) cell clusters.

lectures.topic: Scalable Manifold Learning: UMAP & Autoencoders Intuition
lectures.desc: Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP) Riemannian geometry principles; Global structure preservation comparison (t-SNE vs UMAP); Conceptual introduction to Deep Autoencoders.
lectures.outcome: Contrast UMAP and t-SNE in scalability and global structure fidelity; Understand latent bottleneck autoencoders.
lectures.pedagogy: Side-by-side run on MNIST 70,000 digits benchmarking execution time and visual clustering.
lectures.example: Visualizing 100,000 word embeddings in Natural Language Processing (Word2Vec / BERT).

lectures.topic: Academic Task: Test 2 / Continuous Assessment Review
lectures.desc: Objective and Subjective In-Class Assessment (CA Test 2) covering DBSCAN, Dimensionality Reduction (PCA, t-SNE, UMAP), and Feature Representation Learning.
lectures.outcome: Demonstrate rigorous theoretical and practical problem-solving across Units 3 & 4.
lectures.pedagogy: Formal structured written/LMS assessment test.
lectures.example: Evaluation of covariance matrices, eigenvector calculations, and manifold hyperparameters.

lectures.topic: Association Rule Mining: Apriori Algorithm Mechanics
lectures.desc: Market Basket Analysis foundations; Itemsets, transactions, and rule formats (A -> B); Key metrics: Support, Confidence, Lift, and Conviction; Apriori downward-closure property.
lectures.outcome: Extract strong association rules and interpret Lift to discard coincidental item correlations.
lectures.pedagogy: Supermarket shopping cart board game with transaction frequency tables.
lectures.example: Amazon 'Frequently Bought Together' cross-sell recommendation engines.

lectures.topic: Capstone Project Review: Phase-1 Architecture Evaluation
lectures.desc: Formal evaluation of Continuous Assessment Capstone Project: Problem definition, EDA, data pipeline, and initial model benchmarking presented by student groups.
lectures.outcome: Defend end-to-end unsupervised design choices, baseline models, and code architecture.
lectures.pedagogy: Interactive peer critique and rubric-based faculty technical viva.
lectures.example: Live code walkthrough of end-to-end industry analytics repositories.

lectures.topic: Scalable Rule Mining: FP-Growth (Frequent Pattern Tree)
lectures.desc: Computational bottlenecks of candidate generation in Apriori; FP-Tree compact data structure construction; Mining frequent itemsets without candidate generation.
lectures.outcome: Deploy FP-Growth algorithm for orders-of-magnitude faster association mining on sparse datasets.
lectures.pedagogy: Interactive FP-tree building walkthrough with prefix path mining.
lectures.example: Healthcare adverse drug reaction combination mining from prescription databases.

lectures.topic: Anomaly & Outlier Detection: Statistical & Distance Methods
lectures.desc: Defining anomalies: point, contextual, and collective outliers; Z-score and IQR bounds; Distance-based k-NN outlier scores; Local Outlier Factor (LOF) local density estimation.
lectures.outcome: Differentiate global and local outliers and apply LOF to non-uniform density datasets.
lectures.pedagogy: 2D scatter visual highlighting isolated outliers vs local cluster-edge outliers.
lectures.example: Network intrusion detection identifying malicious port-scanning patterns.

lectures.topic: Tree-Based Anomaly Detection: Isolation Forest
lectures.desc: Isolation Forest core philosophy: isolating anomalies rather than profiling normal points; Recursive random partitioning; Average path length in isolation trees; Anomaly score computation.
lectures.outcome: Implement Isolation Forest for high-dimensional anomaly detection with linear time complexity.
lectures.pedagogy: Tree partitioning animation illustrating rapid isolation of rare anomalous points.
lectures.example: Financial banking transaction fraud screening and automated anti-money laundering (AML).

lectures.topic: Probabilistic Clustering: Gaussian Mixture Models (GMM)
lectures.desc: Probability density estimation; Mixture models; Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm: E-step (posterior probabilities) and M-step (parameter updates); Covariance constraints.
lectures.outcome: Apply Gaussian Mixture Models for soft probabilistic clustering and density estimation.
lectures.pedagogy: Overlapping Gaussian bell curves demonstration with soft probabilistic assignment.
lectures.example: Speaker diarization and acoustic speech pattern clustering in audio processing.

lectures.topic: Model Evaluation, Stability Analysis & End-to-End Pipeline
lectures.desc: External validation metrics when ground truth is partially available: Adjusted Rand Index (ARI), Normalized Mutual Information (NMI); Cluster stability under perturbation; Pipeline deployment.
lectures.outcome: Validate unsupervised models using ARI/NMI and evaluate clustering robustness via bootstrap resampling.
lectures.pedagogy: Sensitivity analysis charts and deployment architectural diagrams.
lectures.example: Verifying customer segmentation model stability across consecutive quarters.

lectures.topic: Spill Over Lecture 1: Advanced Anomaly & Deep Generative Models
lectures.desc: Buffer lecture for advanced applications: Deep Autoencoders for anomaly detection, Variational Autoencoders (VAE) overview, and Self-Organizing Maps (SOM).
lectures.outcome: Appraise state-of-the-art unsupervised deep representation and reconstruction methods.
lectures.pedagogy: Architecture diagrams and code demonstration of autoencoder reconstruction error.
lectures.example: Industrial sensor telemetry predictive maintenance and turbine fault anticipation.

lectures.topic: Spill Over Lecture 2: Real-World Case Studies & Deployment
lectures.desc: Buffer lecture for end-to-end case studies: Deploying unsupervised models with Scikit-learn pipelines; Model serialization (joblib/pickle); Real-time inference latency.
lectures.outcome: Package and deploy unsupervised pipelines as web endpoints or batch analytics jobs.
lectures.pedagogy: Interactive live demo deploying a clustering REST API endpoint.
lectures.example: Production deployment of customer classification microservice on AWS / Docker.

lectures.topic: Spill Over Lecture 3: Comprehensive Course Review & Capstone Viva
lectures.desc: Comprehensive review of all 6 course units; Summary of key algorithmic decisions; Final Project evaluation, student Q&A, and ETT preparation guidance.
lectures.outcome: Synthesize complete knowledge of unsupervised learning algorithms and excel in final evaluations.
lectures.pedagogy: Rapid-fire conceptual quiz, algorithmic decision cheat-sheet distribution.
lectures.example: Preparation for senior machine learning engineer and data scientist technical interviews.
